goal: Align macOS packaged runtime with WorkBuddy/Codex-style preinstalled runtime expectations for out-of-box browser/CDP, OCR, Vision, Node, npm, and npx availability.

changes: Add Node runtime staging for darwin-arm64 and darwin-x64 using Node 22.22.0 by default.
Verify staged node, npm, and npx executables before writing runtime manifest.
Install Playwright Chromium into runtime/playwright-browsers with PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH.
Record nodeVersion and playwrightBrowserInstall in runtime-manifest.json.
Use repo-root runtime-packs and install-capability.py sources to match Windows packaging source paths.
Set PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH and ECOREX_PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_DIR in isolated tool environments when bundled browsers exist.
Support new Playwright Chrome for Testing layouts such as chrome-win64/chrome.exe.
Support chrome-mac* and chrome-headless-shell-* layouts for macOS/Linux/Windows fallback discovery.
Prefer packaged runtime/playwright-browsers before falling back to inherited or userData capability browser paths on macOS.
Export both PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH and ECOREX_PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_DIR to the sidecar only when a managed browser directory is available.
Scan both runtime and state roots for Playwright Chromium.
Report bundled browser assets as ecorex-bundled-playwright.
Redact workspace-root paths from capability-state, permission-matrix, and final release gate artifacts.
Redact runtime/state/output/workspace paths and sensitive exception text from release-gate failure artifacts.
Keep public release evidence to placeholders, counts, categories, and low-risk diagnostic summaries.

commands.command: privacy scan over docs/v0.2.7/artifacts/web-runtime-release-gate-staged for raw workspace/sensitive-value patterns

limits: Full macOS package execution requires a macOS runner; this Windows host verified script syntax and static packaging contracts only.
The staged release gate evidence was produced against the Windows staged runtime, proving the shared resolver/baseline recognizes bundled Node and Playwright browser assets.
